name: AR_DETAILED_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL
description: This table contains the prorated detailed accounting distributions derived from the AR_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL table, along with their account balances.

columns.name: DETAILED_DIST_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a record in this table that represents detailed distributions.

columns.name: SOURCE_DIST_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the source distribution for which the detailed distributions are created.  This is a foreign key to the table AR_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL.

columns.name: PRIOR_DETAILED_DIST_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the original detailed distribution entry in this table, used to create the reversal entry.

columns.name: AMOUNT_DR
columns.description: Distribution accounted debit amount.

columns.name: AMOUNT_CR
columns.description: Distribution accounted credit amount.

columns.name: ACCTD_AMOUNT_DR
columns.description: Journal entry accounted debit amount.

columns.name: ACCTD_AMOUNT_CR
columns.description: Journal entry accounted credit amount.

columns.name: FROM_AMOUNT_DR
columns.description: Debit amount in the currency of the cash receipt.

columns.name: FROM_AMOUNT_CR
columns.description: Credit amount in the currency of the cash receipt.

columns.name: FROM_ACCTD_AMOUNT_DR
columns.description: Debit amount in the ledger currency based on the receipt.

columns.name: FROM_ACCTD_AMOUNT_CR
columns.description: Credit amount in the ledger currency based on the receipt.

columns.name: BALANCE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Balance amount in the ledger currency that is available against the distribution account represented by this record after performing the current activity.

columns.name: BALANCE_ACCTD_AMOUNT
columns.description: Balance amount in the ledger currency that is available against the distribution account represented by this record after performing the current activity.

columns.name: ASSOCIATED_DIST_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the distribution that is used to prorate the activity amount on this split distribution.

columns.name: LATEST_ACTIVITY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the record represents the latest balance against the distribution account.

columns.name: SOURCE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the record in the SOURCE_TABLE that created this prorated distribution.

columns.name: SOURCE_TABLE
columns.description: Possible values are CRH for the AR_CASH_RECEIPT_HISTORY_ALL table, RA for the AR_RECEIVABLE_APPLICATIONS_ALL table, ADJ for the AR_ADJUSTMENTS_ALL table, MCD for the AR_MISC_CASH_DISTRIBUTIONS_ALL table, or TH for the AR_TRANSACTION_HISTORY_ALL table.

columns.name: SOURCE_TYPE
columns.description: Account type of transaction for which distribution is posted.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: APP_SOURCE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the receivable application that is used on a receipt or credit memo.

columns.name: CASH_RECEIPT_HISTORY_ID
columns.description: Cash receipt history identifier.

columns.name: AMOUNT_APPLIED
columns.description: Total amount applied in the currency of the receipt and the transaction for prorating the amounts on detailed distributions.

columns.name: AMOUNT_APPLIED_FROM
columns.description: Total amount applied in the currency of the receipt for prorating the amounts on detailed distributions. This applies to cross-currency applications only.

columns.name: EARNED_DISCOUNT_TAKEN
columns.description: Amount of earned discount taken on the transaction while applying the receipt.

columns.name: UNEARNED_DISCOUNT_TAKEN
columns.description: Amount of unearned discount taken on the transaction while applying the receipt.

columns.name: ACCTD_AMOUNT_APPLIED_FROM
columns.description: Receipt amount in the ledger currency derived using the receipt conversion rate.

columns.name: ACCTD_AMOUNT_APPLIED_TO
columns.description: Receipt amount in the ledger currency applied to the transaction derived using the transaction conversion rate.

columns.name: ACCTD_UNEARNED_DISCOUNT_TAKEN
columns.description: Amount of earned discount in the ledger currency derived using the transaction conversion rate.

columns.name: ACCTD_EARNED_DISCOUNT_TAKEN
columns.description: Amount of unearned discount in the ledger currency derived using the transaction conversion rate.

columns.name: REF_CUSTOMER_TRX_LINE_ID
columns.description: Referenced transaction line identifier.

columns.name: REF_CUST_TRX_LINE_GL_DIST_ID
columns.description: Transaction line distribution identifier.

columns.name: REF_ACCOUNT_CLASS
columns.description: Account class associated with the split distribution. Possible values are FREIGHT for Freight account class, REC for Receivable account class, REV for Revenue account class, TAX for Tax account class, UNBILL for Unbilled Receivable account class, UNEARN for Unearned Revenue account class, ROUND for Rounding account class and SUSPENSE for Suspense account class.

columns.name: ACTIVITY_BUCKET
columns.description: Amount bucket associated with the split distribution.

columns.name: FROM_TO_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether the record is for an Invoice, credit memo, or receipt. Used for internal program processing.

columns.name: TAXABLE_ENTERED_DR
columns.description: Debit taxable amount in transaction currency that is applicable on the activity.

columns.name: TAXABLE_ENTERED_CR
columns.description: Credit taxable amount in transaction currency that is applicable on the activity.

columns.name: TAXABLE_ACCOUNTED_DR
columns.description: Debit taxable amount in ledger currency that is applicable on the activity.

columns.name: TAXABLE_ACCOUNTED_CR
columns.description: Credit taxable amount in ledger currency that is applicable on the activity.

columns.name: REF_DIST_CCID
columns.description: Accounting code combination identifier used at the time of transaction application. This value optimizes performance when the code combination identifier comes from a distribution line outside of Receivables.

columns.name: DETAILED_DIST_ENTRY
columns.description: Indicates whether the distribution requires multifund accounting.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.
